body:
# Modpack for BGames players
This is modpack for **BGames Players**. Contains many mods and texture packs including the official pack on BGames

# About Modpack
This modpack is like Vanilla but with mods for optimization and a better gaming experience. Mods for optimization are like **Sodium** or **Lithium** and for a better experience like **Zoom** or **Not Enough Animations**. It also contains Texture Packs for better gaming on the **BGames** server including the official Texture Pack

# Permission Notice
This Modpack is made by Fan. We have permisions from owner of BGames to make this modpack, thanks to [MrBirchCZ](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6j9WPYpZMMhhib--hfJPKA) for giving us permissions

# Setting Modes
Please do not update the mods in the modpack, especially Simple Voice Chat, for server functionality
